description:
Kim Ki-Beom was sickly since birth and 
lived a life close to death, but his passion was hotter than anyone else's. He continued his passionate activities for Christianity while going through various incidents, but
even after becoming a pastor, the numerous illnesses that plagued him did not go away, and only desperate incidents continued... This is the story of the life of Kim Ki-beom, the first Korean pastor who evangelized numerous people in Incheon despite continuous hardships .
